description: Retrieve transactions, optionally filtered by date range, account, category, tag, recurring item, status, and more. Returns at most `limit` transactions (default 1000, max 2000); `has_more` is set on the response when more match the filters. Pending and split-parent / group-child transactions are excluded by default.

category_id.description: Filter by category ID. 0 returns only un-categorized transactions. Matches both leaf categories and category groups.

created_since.description: Only return transactions created after this timestamp, given as a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO 8601 datetime. Date-only values are read as midnight UTC.

end_date.description: End of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be sent together with start_date.

include_children.description: Populate the `children` array on group parents with their grouped transactions, or, when include_split_parents is also set, on split parents with the transactions split from them.

include_files.description: Include the `files` array (attachment metadata) on each transaction.

include_group_children.description: Include the original transactions that were combined into transaction groups.

include_metadata.description: Include plaid_metadata and custom_metadata fields on each transaction.

include_pending.description: Include imported pending transactions in results. Defaults to false. Ignored when is_pending is set.

include_split_parents.description: Include the original parent transactions of split transactions.

is_group_parent.description: If true, returns only transaction groups (group parents). If false, returns only non-group transactions.

is_pending.description: Filter by pending status. true returns only pending transactions, false only non-pending. Takes precedence over include_pending when set.

manual_account_id.description: Filter by manual account ID, or 0 to omit all manual-account transactions. 0 together with plaid_account_id 0 returns transactions with no account.

offset.description: Offset for pagination. Use with `has_more` from a previous response.

plaid_account_id.description: Filter by Plaid account ID, or 0 to omit all Plaid-account transactions. 0 together with manual_account_id 0 returns transactions with no account.

start_date.description: Beginning of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be sent together with end_date.

tag_id.description: Filter to transactions that have this tag ID.

updated_since.description: Only return transactions updated after this timestamp, given as a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO 8601 datetime. Date-only values are read as midnight UTC.

name: get_transactions
